snippet.title: [ARCADE SHOWCASE] Magical Date EX - Sotsugyou Kokuhaku Daisakusen (Walkthrough)
snippet.description:
If you want to see the ending, go to 6:06

Magical Date EX - Sotsugyou Kokuhaku Daisakusen (まじかるで～と　卒業告白大作戦. Literally, "Battle for Confession Graduation") Is a arcade dating game developed and published by Taito. The player may pick one of 3 dates, each with their own personalities, difficulty, favourite locations and outfits to discover.

This is the game completed whit the most difficult girl, Kasumi Fuyuno. I edited all the gameplay -because is random picked by the machine- and only have left the questions the game asks -Just the final one is kind of tricky...wonder if its the correct one.

Kasumi Fuyuno (冬野 霞 - ふゆの かすみ)
School: Amatsuki Academy - 2nd Year
Birthday: 23rd November (Sagittarius)
Blood Type: AB
Three sizes: B 82 / W 58 / H 83
Personality: Kind of Shy, Kind of Silent, you never know what is she thinking.

Real gameplay time to finish it: 37 minutes on speedrun, 50 minutes on normal.
